q19592.en: The sign shown is a prohibition sign.

explain.short: A red circle on white is the shape of prohibition signs: this one forbids going over 80 km/h.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'divieto' means prohibition: the red ring tells you something is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Red ring = prohibition: no faster than 80

q19593.en: Where the sign shown is present, it is forbidden to exceed a speed of 80 km/h.

explain.short: The 80 inside the red ring is a maximum: driving faster than 80 km/h is forbidden.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'superare' here means going above a speed, not overtaking a car.

sceneParams.caption: Max 80 km/h: going faster is forbidden

q19594.en: The sign shown can also be found on motorways.

explain.short: Speed limit signs are used on every kind of road, motorways included, for example near roadworks or bends.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'anche' means 'also': the sign is not only for ordinary roads.

sceneParams.caption: Speed limits appear on motorways too

q19595.en: The speed limit shown on the sign is valid immediately after the sign itself.

explain.short: Prohibition signs are placed where the rule starts: the limit applies right from the sign.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'immediatamente' means at once: no 150 m warning distance, unlike danger signs.

sceneParams.caption: The limit starts right at the sign

q19596.en: The sign shown requires you to drive at a speed lower than or equal to 80 km/h.

explain.short: A maximum of 80 means 80 km/h or less is fine; only more than 80 is forbidden.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'inferiore o uguale' means 'less than or equal': 80 itself is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: 80 km/h or less is OK

q19597.en: The sign shown is a prescription sign.

explain.short: Prescription signs (segnali di prescrizione) are the signs that give orders; prohibition signs are one kind of them.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' covers prohibition, obligation and right-of-way signs, so it fits here too.

sceneParams.caption: Prohibition signs are prescription signs

q19598.en: The sign shown requires you to keep a safety distance of at least 80 metres.

explain.short: The 80 is a speed in km/h, not a distance in metres: the sign sets a maximum speed.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'distanza di sicurezza' (safety distance) is a different topic: the number is km/h.

sceneParams.caption: 80 is km/h, not a distance in metres

q19599.en: The sign shown does not apply to motorcycles.

explain.short: A speed limit sign applies to all vehicles, motorcycles included, unless a panel below says otherwise.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'non si riferisce' (does not apply): the limit is for everyone.

sceneParams.caption: Motorbikes must respect the limit too

q19600.en: The sign shown indicates the recommended speed.

explain.short: This is a compulsory maximum, not advice. A recommended speed has a different, square blue sign.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'consigliata' means only advised; a red ring is an order, not a suggestion.

sceneParams.caption: Not advice: 80 is a compulsory maximum

q19601.en: The sign shown allows you to overtake at a speed above 80 km/h.

explain.short: The limit has no exception for overtaking: you may never go above 80 km/h, not even to pass someone.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'sorpasso' (overtaking) does not cancel the limit.

sceneParams.caption: No exception for overtaking: max 80

q19602.en: The sign shown bans vehicles with a total mass over 80 quintals.

explain.short: A number alone in a red ring is a speed in km/h. A weight limit shows a 't' (tonnes) on a different sign.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'massa' (mass, weight) and 'quintali' are wrong: the number is a speed.

sceneParams.caption: 80 is a speed, not a weight

q19603.en: The sign shown requires you to respect a minimum speed limit.

explain.short: A red ring sets a MAXIMUM speed. A minimum speed has a blue round sign with a white number.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'minimo' (minimum) is the trap: red ring = maximum.

sceneParams.caption: Red ring = maximum, not minimum

q19604.en: The sign shown bans vehicles that, by design, cannot reach the speed shown.

explain.short: The sign only forbids going faster than 80 km/h. Slow vehicles may still use the road.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (bans transit): this sign bans speed above 80, not slow vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Slow vehicles may still pass: it is a maximum

q19605.en: The sign shown forbids vehicles to exceed the speed shown.

explain.short: The number is the top speed: going above 80 km/h is forbidden for every vehicle.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'superare' here means going above the speed, not overtaking.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicle may go above 80 km/h

q19606.en: The sign shown requires you to respect a maximum speed limit.

explain.short: The red ring with a number is the maximum speed limit sign.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'massimo' (maximum) is right; the trap version says 'minimo'.

sceneParams.caption: Red ring with a number = maximum speed

q19607.en: The sign shown indicates the maximum speed at which vehicles may travel.

explain.short: The number 80 is the highest speed allowed on that stretch.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'massima' means highest: you may go slower, never faster.

sceneParams.caption: 80 is the top speed allowed

q19608.en: The sign shown requires you to travel at a speed not above 80 km/h.

explain.short: 'Not above 80' is just another way to say a maximum of 80 km/h.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'non superiore' means 'not more than': 80 or less.

sceneParams.caption: Not more than 80 km/h

q19609.en: The number shown on the sign indicates the maximum speed allowed.

explain.short: The number is in km/h and is the highest speed allowed.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'consentita' means allowed: the number is the allowed maximum.

sceneParams.caption: The number = maximum speed allowed

q19610.en: The sign shown allows you to drive at a speed lower than the one shown.

explain.short: A maximum limit only forbids going faster; driving slower than 80 km/h is allowed.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'inferiore' means lower: below the maximum is fine.

sceneParams.caption: Slower than 80 is allowed

q19611.en: The sign shown indicates a speed limit valid only for motor vehicles (cars, trucks).

explain.short: Without a panel below, the limit applies to every vehicle, motorbikes and mopeds too.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: the limit is for all.

sceneParams.caption: The limit applies to all vehicles

q19612.en: The sign shown requires you to respect the minimum speed limit shown.

explain.short: The red ring shows a maximum. A minimum speed has a blue round sign.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'minimo' (minimum) is the trap: red ring = maximum.

sceneParams.caption: Red ring = maximum, not minimum

q19613.en: The sign shown requires vehicles that cannot exceed 80 km/h to drive in the right-hand lane.

explain.short: The sign only sets a maximum speed. It says nothing about lanes for slow vehicles.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'corsia di destra' (right lane): lanes are not part of this sign.

sceneParams.caption: It sets a top speed, not a lane

q19614.en: The speed limit shown by the sign comes into force 150 metres after the sign itself.

explain.short: Prohibition signs apply right at the sign. The 150 m distance is for danger signs.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: '150 metri dopo' is copied from danger signs; this limit starts at once.

sceneParams.caption: The limit starts at the sign, not 150 m later

q19615.en: The sign shown bans motor vehicles with a total mass over the value shown.

explain.short: A number alone in a red ring is a speed in km/h, not a weight. Weight limits show 't' (tonnes).
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'massa complessiva' (total mass) is wrong: the number is a speed.

sceneParams.caption: 80 is a speed, not a weight

q19616.en: The sign shown indicates a speed limit valid from 8.00 to 20.00.

explain.short: Without a time panel below it, the limit is valid at all hours, day and night.
explain.rule: The red circle with '80' is the 'limite massimo di velocità' (maximum speed limit) sign: a prohibition sign. From the sign onwards, every vehicle must not go faster than 80 km/h.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 8.00 alle ore 20.00': no panel with hours, so no time limit.

sceneParams.caption: Valid at all hours, day and night

q19617.en: The sign shown bans the use of the horn.

explain.short: The crossed-out horn in a red ring means: do not sound the horn (clacson).
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'clacson' is the horn; 'vieta' means forbids.

sceneParams.caption: No horn from this sign

q19618.en: The sign shown bans sound signals.

explain.short: 'Segnalazioni acustiche' (sound signals) means using the horn: this sign forbids them.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'acustiche' means made with sound: the official name for horn signals.

sceneParams.caption: No sound signals (horn)

q19620.en: The sign shown marks the start of a zone where sounding the horn is forbidden.

explain.short: The ban starts at the sign and lasts until the end-of-ban sign.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'inizio' (start) is right; the end sign has a grey diagonal bar instead.

sceneParams.caption: From here: horn forbidden

q19621.en: Where the sign shown is present, you may use the horn if you are carrying injured or seriously ill people.

explain.short: The ban has exceptions for real emergencies, such as carrying badly injured or sick people, and for immediate danger.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'se' (if) gives a real exception: a medical emergency.

sceneParams.caption: Emergency with injured on board: horn allowed

q19622.en: The sign shown allows using the horn to attract attention in any situation.

explain.short: The sign forbids the horn. It is allowed only for immediate danger or emergencies, not 'in any situation'.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'qualsiasi circostanza' (any situation) is the trap: only emergencies.

sceneParams.caption: Horn forbidden: only for real danger

q19623.en: The sign shown must be respected only from 20.00 to 8.00.

explain.short: Without a time panel, the ban is valid at all hours, not only at night.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) plus night hours: there is no time panel.

sceneParams.caption: No-horn ban: valid day and night

q19624.en: The sign shown warns that you may come across a fire station.

explain.short: A red ring is a prohibition, not a warning. The picture is a crossed-out horn: no horn.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'preavvisa' (warns ahead) belongs to triangle danger signs, not to this one.

sceneParams.caption: It bans the horn, it does not warn of firemen

q19625.en: The sign shown warns of a road narrowing on mountain roads.

explain.short: This is a no-horn sign, not a danger sign. A narrowing (strettoia) has a red triangle.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'strettoia' (narrowing) is a different, triangular sign.

sceneParams.caption: No horn: not a narrowing

q19626.en: The sign shown allows using the horn in traffic jams.

explain.short: A traffic jam is not a danger or an emergency, so the horn stays forbidden.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'ingorgo' (traffic jam) is not an allowed exception.

sceneParams.caption: Traffic jam: still no horn

q19627.en: The sign shown marks the end of the ban on sound signals.

explain.short: This red-ring sign is the START of the ban. The end sign is white-grey with a diagonal bar.
explain.rule: The red circle with a crossed-out horn is 'divieto di segnalazioni acustiche' (no horn). From the sign you must not use the horn, except for immediate danger or real emergencies.
explain.trap: 'fine' (end) is the trap: red ring = the ban begins.

sceneParams.caption: Red ring = ban starts, not ends

q19628.en: The sign shown forbids vehicles over 3.5 tonnes full-load mass, not used to carry people, to overtake motor vehicles.

explain.short: The red lorry stands for goods vehicles over 3.5 t: they must not overtake motor vehicles.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'non destinati al trasporto di persone' (not for carrying people): buses are not included.

sceneParams.caption: Goods vehicles over 3.5 t: no overtaking

keywords.it: non destinati al trasporto di persone

q19629.en: Where the sign shown is present, a lorry may not overtake motor vehicles if its registration document shows a full-load mass over 3.5 tonnes.

explain.short: The weight that counts is the full-load mass written on the registration document (carta di circolazione).
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'carta di circolazione' (registration document): the weight on paper counts, not the real load today.

sceneParams.caption: Truck over 3.5 t on paper: no overtaking

q19630.en: The sign shown allows a lorry with a full-load mass below 3.5 tonnes to overtake an articulated lorry.

explain.short: The ban is only for goods vehicles over 3.5 t. A lighter truck may overtake.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'inferiore' (below) 3.5 t: under the limit, so the ban does not apply.

sceneParams.caption: Truck under 3.5 t may overtake

q19631.en: The sign shown allows a bus with a full-load mass of 18 tonnes to overtake a lorry with trailer.

explain.short: Buses carry people, so the ban does not apply to them, whatever their weight.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: '18 tonnellate' looks heavy, but a bus (autobus) carries people: no ban.

sceneParams.caption: Buses carry people: they may overtake

q19632.en: Where the sign shown is present, a car with a full-load mass of 3 tonnes towing a small trailer may overtake motor vehicles.

explain.short: A car carries people and weighs under 3.5 t: the ban does not apply, even with a small trailer.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'carrello appendice' (small luggage trailer) does not turn a car into a goods vehicle.

sceneParams.caption: Car with small trailer: may overtake

q19633.en: Where the sign shown is present, a car may overtake a lorry with trailer.

explain.short: The ban is only for heavy goods vehicles. Cars may still overtake, trucks included.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'autovettura' (car): the sign does not stop cars from overtaking.

sceneParams.caption: Cars may overtake trucks here

q19634.en: Where the sign shown is present, a camper van with a full-load mass of 4 tonnes may overtake.

explain.short: A camper van (autocaravan) is not a goods vehicle, so the ban does not apply even over 3.5 t.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: '4 tonnellate' is over 3.5 t, but the ban is only for goods vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Camper over 3.5 t: may still overtake

q19635.en: Where the sign shown is present, lorries with a full-load mass over 3.5 t are forbidden to overtake a motorcycle.

explain.short: A motorcycle is a motor vehicle, and heavy trucks may not overtake any motor vehicle.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'motociclo' (motorcycle) is small, but it is still a motor vehicle.

sceneParams.caption: Heavy truck may not pass a motorbike

q19636.en: Where the sign shown is present, a lorry over 3.5 tonnes full-load mass, towing a light trailer, may overtake a motorcycle.

explain.short: The truck is over 3.5 t, so it may not overtake any motor vehicle, motorbikes included. The trailer changes nothing.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'rimorchio leggero' (light trailer) is a distraction: the truck is still over 3.5 t.

sceneParams.caption: Truck over 3.5 t: no overtaking, even a motorbike

q19637.en: Where the sign shown is present, a camper van over 3.5 tonnes full-load mass may not overtake motor vehicles.

explain.short: A camper van is not a goods vehicle, so it may overtake even when it is over 3.5 t.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'autocaravan' (camper van): the weight is a trap, the ban is only for goods vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Camper over 3.5 t: overtaking allowed

q19638.en: The sign shown allows a lorry with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes to overtake a motorcycle.

explain.short: Heavy trucks may not overtake any motor vehicle, and a motorcycle is one.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) is the trap: it is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Heavy truck may not pass a motorbike

q19639.en: The sign shown allows cars to overtake lorries in the right-hand lane.

explain.short: The sign is about heavy trucks not overtaking. It gives nobody permission to overtake on the right.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'corsia di destra' (right lane): overtaking normally stays on the left.

sceneParams.caption: No overtaking on the right: trucks' ban only

q19640.en: The sign shown forbids articulated buses to overtake.

explain.short: An autosnodato is an articulated bus that carries people, so the ban does not apply to it.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'autosnodati' are bendy buses, not goods trucks.

sceneParams.caption: Articulated buses carry people: may overtake

q19641.en: The sign shown forbids a camper van with a total mass of 6 tonnes to overtake.

explain.short: Camper vans are not goods vehicles, so they may overtake whatever their weight.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: '6 tonnellate' is a weight trap: the ban is only for goods vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Camper of any weight: may overtake

q19642.en: Where the sign shown is present, a lorry with a full-load mass of 3 tonnes may not overtake.

explain.short: 3 t is not over 3.5 t, so this light truck may overtake.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: '3 tonnellate' is under the 3.5 t threshold.

sceneParams.caption: Truck of 3 t: below the limit, may overtake

q19643.en: Where the sign shown is present, vehicles over 3.5 tonnes full-load mass used to carry people may not overtake.

explain.short: The ban is for goods vehicles. Vehicles that carry people, like buses, may overtake.
explain.rule: A red circle with a red lorry next to a black car is 'divieto di sorpasso per i veicoli di massa superiore a 3,5 t'. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t (full load) must not overtake motor vehicles; cars, buses and campers may.
explain.trap: 'trasporto di persone' (carrying people): exactly the vehicles NOT covered.

sceneParams.caption: People carriers over 3.5 t: may overtake

q19644.en: The sign shown bans animal-drawn vehicles.

explain.short: The horse and cart in a red ring mean: no vehicles pulled by animals.
explain.rule: A red circle with a horse and cart is 'transito vietato ai veicoli a trazione animale' (no animal-drawn vehicles). Only carts pulled by animals are banned; motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'trazione animale' means pulled by animals.

sceneParams.caption: No animal-drawn vehicles

q19645.en: The sign shown bans vehicles pulled by horses.

explain.short: Horse-drawn vehicles are animal-drawn vehicles, so they are banned.
explain.rule: A red circle with a horse and cart is 'transito vietato ai veicoli a trazione animale' (no animal-drawn vehicles). Only carts pulled by animals are banned; motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'trainati da cavalli' (pulled by horses) is one kind of 'trazione animale'.

sceneParams.caption: Horse-drawn vehicles: banned

sceneParams.caption: Pedestrians banned, not sent to the left

explain.trap: 'percorso pedonale' (pedestrian path) is the blue sign, not this red one.

sceneParams.caption: Red = no pedestrians; blue = path for them

explain.trap: 'biciclette' means bicycles; 'vieta' means forbids.
